en: The image depicts a vibrant European city square with several open-air market stalls covered by white umbrellas. The square is surrounded by ornate, multi-story historic buildings with red-tiled roofs. In the center of the square, there is a prominent statue or monument with figures around its base. At the back, on a hill, a distinctive clock tower overlooks the scene. Several shop signs on the buildings are visible, including 'DAMEN-HUT SALON' and others in German.
